generated_output.summary: When multiple agent calls share a workspace root with different visible skills, concurrent orphan garbage collection in MarketplaceStager can delete files out from under an active directory traversal. This throws a NoSuchFileException wrapped in an UncheckedIOException, escaping the try-catch block and terminating the entire agent execution.
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: Garbage collection methods like garbageCollectOrphans(), deleteRecursively(), and removeUnexpected() catch checked IOException but fail to catch RuntimeException / UncheckedIOException thrown by lazy stream traversal when files disappear concurrently. Additionally, garbage collection is executed outside the protective try-catch boundaries of individual skill staging.

step_by_step_plan.title: Inspect MarketplaceStager traversal and error boundaries
step_by_step_plan.description: Inspect the directory traversal and file deletion logic in MarketplaceStager and ReActAgent.java to locate where Files.walk or recursive deletion streams throw UncheckedIOException due to concurrent file disappearance.

step_by_step_plan.title: Catch UncheckedIOException and NoSuchFileException
step_by_step_plan.description: Wrap directory traversal and cleanup actions (such as garbageCollectOrphans(), deleteRecursively(), and removeUnexpected()) in robust try-catch blocks or stream operators that gracefully catch UncheckedIOException and NoSuchFileException when concurrently modified paths vanish.

step_by_step_plan.title: Ensure safe protection boundaries around skill staging
step_by_step_plan.description: Verify that individual skill staging and concurrent workspace root operations are protected from unexpected runtime exceptions, ensuring orphan cleanups do not terminate agent execution.

step_by_step_plan.title: Add regression test for concurrent skill staging and workspace garbage collection
step_by_step_plan.description: Implement a regression test simulating concurrent agent calls sharing a workspace root with differing visible skills to ensure no NoSuchFileException or UncheckedIOException escapes during orphan garbage collection.

step_by_step_plan.title: Run test suite verification
step_by_step_plan.description: Run the repository test command to verify that all agent executions complete successfully under concurrent workspace modifications.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Java NIO file streams like Files.walk() throw runtime UncheckedIOException when an underlying file or directory is deleted mid-traversal.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Developers must catch runtime exceptions around NIO streams when working in concurrent or multi-threaded environments where files can change unexpectedly.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: Catching UncheckedIOException during directory walking and orphan cleanup prevents abrupt agent failure when concurrent calls modify shared cache directories.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Ensuring multiple concurrent tasks do not interfere with shared resources through proper scoping, locking, or fault tolerance.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Shared filesystem resources in multi-user applications are vulnerable to race conditions if caching and cleanup mechanisms are not designed for concurrency.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: The issue stems from shared cache garbage collection across concurrent agent calls with different skill visibilities.

common_pitfalls: Catching only checked IOException while ignoring RuntimeException / UncheckedIOException thrown by NIO stream operations.
Performing cleanup or garbage collection of shared cache directories outside safe try-catch boundaries.
